core.title: Riverton Rowing Club autumn regatta entries
core.setting: The club secretary of Riverton Rowing Club whose assistant maintains membership rolls, regatta entries, and boat bookings

events.text: Standing instruction from the committee: once a regatta entry is confirmed, the boat, crew or race date on that booking may only be changed with the Captain, Idris, agreeing first.
Club rule: any order above 300 pounds needs the treasurer's sign-off before it is placed.
The Wyndham Regatta 2026 will be held on Saturday 17 October. Entry fee is 36 pounds per four and entries close on 2 October.
Boat availability note: the quad Heron and the double Swift are both in service and free for club racing through the autumn.
Kestrel Trailers quotes 120 pounds for a local tow to a one-day regatta within 40 miles, driver included.
Harbour Lights Catering quotes 210 pounds for a regatta-day picnic for 30 people, delivered to the venue.
Entered the mixed four at the Wyndham Regatta on 17 October and paid the 36 pounds entry fee as instructed by the committee.
Booked the quad Heron for the morning of the Wyndham Regatta on 17 October so the mixed four can race.
Crew for the four at Wyndham is confirmed: Priya, Sam, Aled and Rachel. We are all free on 17 October.
Ordered the trailer from Kestrel Trailers for the Wyndham Regatta tow on 17 October at their quoted 120 pounds, under the 300 pound limit so no treasurer sign-off was needed.
Great that the Wyndham entry is in. I'll bring the club flag and the gazebo on the day.
The Pellow Head race 2026 will be held on Saturday 7 November. Entry fee is 20 pounds per double and entries close on 30 October.
The double Swift has been serviced and is in good repair, ready for the autumn head races.
Two of my blades have loose collars. I'll drop them at the boathouse this week for repair.
From 1 September our local regatta tow rate goes up to 135 pounds. Everything already confirmed stays at its booked price.
Scheduled the Sunday club rows through the autumn in the quad Heron, weekly at 09:00, since both boats are available.
Committee minutes: autumn finances healthy; regatta entries proceeding as planned; new members welcome evening set for October.
Assigned Aled as the trailer driver for the Wyndham Regatta tow on 17 October, following on from the Kestrel trailer order already placed.
Booked Harbour Lights Catering for the regatta-day picnic on 17 October at their quoted 210 pounds, under the 300 pound limit so no treasurer sign-off was needed.
New boathouse key codes issued to all racing members. Old codes stop working at the end of September.
Racing at Wyndham will run over the 1500 metre downstream course as usual.
Entry received for Riverton Rowing Club, mixed four, fee 36 pounds paid, race day Saturday 17 October. Confirmation follows with the draw in early October.
Reminder: the trailer's licence disc expires at the end of October, so make sure the towing vehicle documents are in order for any November trips.
Good news for regatta day: we will run a free shuttle bus between the Harrow Field car park and the boating area every 20 minutes from 08:00 on 17 October. No booking needed, just turn up.
Racing at the Wyndham Regatta starts at 09:30 on 17 October; crews should be at the boating area an hour before their race.
By the way, the Wyndham entry fee for an eight is 48 pounds if we ever want to field one. Could be worth thinking about next season.
Reminder to all crews: Wyndham entries close tomorrow, 2 October.
Wyndham Regatta entries are now closed. The draw will be published next week.
Tomas and I would love to race the double at the Pellow Head on 7 November if the club can enter us.
Both Mira and I hold valid racing licences and we are free on 7 November. The Swift double would suit us well.
